parameters.help_en:
Required. The scope of the key. Valid values:
ALL: All permissions, including read and write operations such as clone, pull, and push.
READ: Read-only permissions, which only support clone and pull operations

必填，作用范围，可选值：ALL、READ

ALL：全部（读/写操作包括 clone/pull/push 等）

READ：只读（仅支持 clone/pull ）
